messages:
Sam: Heads-up — noticed a couple of schema examples in the structured-output guide have drifted vs. the SDK shapes. Also found two broken links in the migration guide PR (#4321). Can we triage a small patch today?

Anya: thanks for flagging. which examples exactly? I skimmed the PR but didn’t run the example harness.

Sam: the main issues: the compact fallback example returns an array where the SDK expects an object (we used to accept both). Also the JSON snippet under `/docs/migration/tool-calling.md` links to a stale gist (404). Quick checklist: fix shape, add a short note about compatibility, and update link.

Marco: I can update the example shape and add a unit test for the docs-runner that validates example -> SDK parse. Will need to know the canonical shape to use. Sam, do you want object-with-envelope or keep array?

Sam: prefer the envelope object to avoid ambiguous parsing. Something like: 
```json
{"invoke": {"tool": "search", "args": {"q": "x"}}, "metadata": {"version":"v2"}}
```
and a fallback paragraph that explains legacy array shapes and how the SDK maps them.

Anya: perfect. I'll prep a tiny wording change and add a one-sentence migration note. Priya — can you confirm SDK behavior so the example matches runtime?

Priya: yup. Current SDK (v1.7.2) treats arrays as legacy and maps to `invoke` envelope, but the parser will soon be stricter in the v2 runtime. We'll call out the deprecation. I can add a short snippet to the SDK examples showing both shapes with a comment: 
```js
// recommended
const resp = { invoke: { tool: 'search', args: { q: 'x' } } }
// legacy array (will be mapped but deprecated)
const legacy = ['search', { q: 'x' }]
```

docs-bot: ci/docs-link-checker failed on PR #4321 — broken link: https://gist.github.com/redwood/snippets/old-toolcall-example (404)

Anya: thanks docs-bot — I'll update to point to the new snippet under the docs repo. Where should we put the canonical examples? I prefer /docs/examples/structured-output so links are stable.

Marco: +1. I'll add the fixed JSON and a tiny pytest in infra/docs-tests that pulls the file and runs the parser. Test will be a single assert that parsed_obj.invoke.tool == 'search'.

Priya: I'll add a short SDK unit test too (examples/test_parse_compat.py) so CI catches regressions. Also adding a comment to changelog v2-preview that parser will be stricter.

Kai: quick note — can we also add a simple eval checkpoint so the example doesn't regress? I can add a golden prompt set entry to the evals repo and wire it to the daily drift job. If we add that it helps catch accidental shape regressions.

Sam: good idea. Not required for the emergency patch, but please file a follow-up issue and link it from the PR.

Anya: action items then: 1) Marco: update example JSON under /docs/examples/structured-output/ (3961234567-struct-output.json) + unit test; 2) Sam: update PR description with the canonical shape and deprecation note; 3) Priya: SDK snippet + unit test; 4) Anya: replace the broken gist link with stable docs link and add migration note; 5) Kai: file evals issue and optional golden set addition. I'll do the PR text and link fixes after Marco drops the new example.

Marco: starting PR branch now (refs: github.com/redwood/docs#fix/structured-shape). Will ping when ready for review.

Priya: will add SDK snippet — targetting a small commit to the examples package (no API changes).

Sam: thanks everyone. If anyone runs into long blocking work, leave a short comment here and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:

Anya: quick heads-up: when updating links, please use absolute path to the docs site (https://docs.redwood.ai/examples/structured-output/3961234567-struct-output.json) so the link-checker and the external redirects are happy.

Marco: pushed branch with new example + test, PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4392 — test failing locally due to docs-runner path, looking.

Anya: saw the PR — small nit on wording, I'll add line comments.

Priya: SDK commit ready, opened PR against sdk-examples: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-examples/pull/210 — includes JS snippet and unit test.

docs-bot: ci/docs-runner reported a missing dependency in the test container (python-requests).

Marco: fixing container now. ETA 20m.

Kai: filed evals issue: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/124 — describes golden prompt + daily regression job.

Sam: all good. Once PRs are green, can we merge and ship a short release note in the changelog? I'd like to mention the stricter parser deprecation in v2 preview.

Anya: will add release note in docs changelog after merges.

Marco: tests passing now, updated the docs-runner env, force-pushed. PR ready for review.

Anya: reviewing now. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Priya: approved SDK PR.

Anya: merged docs PR and updated the broken link to the stable example URL. Changelog entry added.

Sam: awesome. Closing the loop — thanks everyone. Follow-up: Kai's evals issue will come back for review next week.

Kai: noted. I'll post progress in #eng-ml next week.

Sam: :tada:
